Reads the MPU-6050 over I²C every control_tick: 14 bytes in about 0.4 ms, published as one coherent sample.
REGISTER BANK · base 0x10001000 · ID 0x49324301 · reads are registered (valid next cycle)
Init: wait 50 ms → WHO_AM_I (0x68) → PWR_MGMT_1=0x01 → SMPLRT_DIV=0, CONFIG=2, GYRO=0, ACCEL=0. Burst: START, addr+W, 0x3B, Sr, addr+R, 14 bytes, STOP. tick→imu_valid 380–440 µs.
